docstring:
Counts the number of objects matching a description in an image.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    object_prompt (string): Description of the objects to count.

Returns:
    int: Number of objects matching the description.

Returns the bounding box of the object matching a description that is closest in depth to the camera.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    object_prompt (string): Description of the objects to consider.

Returns:
    list: Bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] of the closest matching object.

Returns the color of the object contained in a bounding box.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    bbox (list): A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] containing the object.

Returns:
    string: Color of the object in the bounding box.

Returns the real-world width of an object in meters, given its bounding box and its real-world height in meters.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    bbox (list): A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] containing the object.
    height_m (float): The real-world height of the object in meters.

Returns:
    float: The real-world width of the object in meters.
